quotes.speaker: Cormac Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Cormac Ryan on Milwaukee Bucks training camp and team habits
quotes.excerpt: We've had a really competitive camp. I think we've done a really good job building habits.
quotes.quote: It's been great. It's been great. We've had a really competitive camp. I think we've done a really good job building habits. Coach has been very clear with his expectations, with the standard that we want to set, and I think we've done a really good job responding to that, respecting it, and just building on it every day.
quotes.social_post: Cormac Ryan says the Bucks are focused on building habits during training camp. He notes that the team has done a good job responding to the coaching staff expectations and standards.

quotes.speaker: Cormac Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Cormac Ryan on his commitment to winning regardless of contract
quotes.excerpt: I'm not too worried about what type of deal I'm on. I'm just worried about impacting winning.
quotes.quote: For me, the hunger and the effort doesn't waver. I was unsigned last year, I was playing just as hard as I am now. And when I sign a $50 million deal, I'll play just as hard as I do now. For me, that's just a non-negotiable and so I'm not too worried about what type of deal I'm on. I'm just worried about impacting winning.
quotes.social_post: Cormac Ryan says his effort remains the same regardless of his contract status. He says the hunger does not waver and he is focused on impacting winning.

quotes.speaker: Cormac Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Cormac Ryan on his role and impact on the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: I'm a guy who can really guard the ball and pick up and help us get stops.
quotes.quote: For me, it starts with effort and energy, competitiveness, so coming in bringing fire. Obviously, it's drilling shots, continuing to use my gravity as a shooter to help the team, and make plays, make the right reads, and compete defensively. I'm a guy who can really guard the ball and pick up and help us get stops. And then in between all of that, it's just the little things: talking, diving on the floor, boxing out, the unsexy things, and those are the things that help you win games.
quotes.social_post: Cormac Ryan describes his role with the Bucks as bringing energy and competitiveness. He highlights his focus on shooting gravity, guarding the ball, and doing the unsexy things like diving on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Cormac Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Cormac Ryan on the depth and chemistry of the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: We've got guys at all different stages of their career. Everyone brings something different.
quotes.quote: It's great. We get to push each other every day. We've got guys at all different stages of their career. So there's a lot of experience, there's guys who are newer, there's guys who are younger, older, and all different skill sets. Everyone brings something different and we get to push each other every day. We get to make each other better and then we all get to go out and compete and help. We're all bought into what Taylor is bringing and the staff and the work.
quotes.social_post: Cormac Ryan praises the depth and chemistry of the Bucks roster, noting that the mix of experience and different skill sets allows the players to push each other every day.

quotes.speaker: Cormac Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Cormac Ryan on executing in late-game situations
quotes.excerpt: It's a great test in the preseason to start executing in late-game situations.
quotes.quote: I think we were proud of the way we pulled out the win. That was a great test in the preseason to start executing in late-game situations. There were things we worked on in practice that we got to carry over to the game right away, which is awesome to be in those situations. Being able to make the right play down the stretch, whether that's a go-ahead basket, getting a stop, rebounding, executing a side out of bounds, those are all things we work on every day.
quotes.social_post: Cormac Ryan says the Bucks were proud of their late-game execution in the preseason. He notes that the team was able to carry over practice work into real game situations down the stretch.

quotes.speaker: Cormac Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Cormac Ryan on the team's resilience and chemistry
quotes.excerpt: We're hungry, we're competitive. I think we have a chip on our shoulder.
quotes.quote: I think we just learned that we're hungry, we're competitive. I think we have a chip on our shoulder. I think we're resilient. We've got guys who have battled back from adversity at different points in their career, each and every one of us. And we've got a talented group. We've got a group that really likes each other and the chemistry on the court, off the court is growing every single day.
quotes.social_post: Cormac Ryan believes the Bucks have a chip on their shoulder this season. He says the group is resilient and that their chemistry is growing every single day.
